thread:
Luca: Heads-up — seeing steady RSS growth on qwen-mqa jobs with long-context traces after the kernel selector switch this morning. Repro on canary.
Amy: @Luca can you paste the profiler slice and the exact kernel flags? :eyes:
Luca: repro steps below, tiny dump attached in logs. main signal is KV pages not getting evicted, allocation count keeps climbing with context length > 64k tokens.
Luca: ```
# repro (canary node)
export MODEL=qwen-mqa-60b
export KERNEL=opt-v2
./run_inference --model $MODEL --kernel $KERNEL --context 80000 --profile
```
Luca: pprof snapshot (heap top entries):
```
250MB  45%  45%  560MB 100%  kv_cache::page_table
120MB  21%  66%  120MB  21%  tensor::alloc::large
60MB   10%  76%  60MB  10%  rope::scale::cached_scales
... (trimmed)
``` 
Raj: interesting — rope cached scales showing up. Could be rope-scaling factor miscomputed for MQA hybrid attention; that would bump per-key size.
Maria: also check batching heuristic. If the batcher switches to longer-prepend caching to avoid recompute, it can pin more KV blocks per request.
Amy: what's the kernel switch exactly? infra-bot earlier rolled opt-v2 -> opt-v2a for the region at 08:12.
infra-bot: deploy infra/canary/opt-v2a rolled by ci-deploy at 2026-03-17T08:12:23Z :white_check_mark:
Luca: yes swapped to opt-v2a which has a new kernel path with cheaper attention kernel but different kv-page alignment (32->48 bytes). Alignment mismatch looks like it prevents coalescing during GC.
Raj: that alignment increase + MQA's sharded KV layout could create fragmentation that prevents page reuse. That will show as growing "resident pages" even if logical entries are evicted.
Amy: can you dump page headers? format is `kvctl dump-pages --node canary --model $MODEL --limit 50`
Luca: did that, sample:
```
page_id: 0x7f9a... size: 4096 used: 0xF00 align: 48 last_touch: 1723456700
page_id: 0x7f9b... size: 4096 used: 0x1F00 align: 32 last_touch: 1723456710
... (many 48-byte aligned entries)
```
Maria: so new kernel uses 48 alignment and we have mixed alignments. GC's coalesce algorithm only merges equal-aligned neighbors. Result: fragmentation.
Raj: quick mitigation: force kernel-legacy-align=32 per-node and run sweep frequency x2. Should free a lot.
Amy: any risk to perf if we revert alignment? latency impact?
Luca: opt-v2a had ~2% latency win on short seqs. Reverting alignment to 32 regains GC coalesce but may lose that 2%. For now I'd rather stop memory growth for long contexts.
Maria: longer-term fix — update coalesce algorithm to normalise to gcd(al1,al2) or to maintain separate free-lists per alignment class and attempt cross-class compaction at sweep time.
Raj: also add a metric: kv_resident_pages_by_alignment to surface this earlier.
Amy: can we add a canary patch: `--kernel-flag align=32` and a batching clamp `batcher.max_prefix_kv=4` to validate impact? Small change surface quickly.
Luca: testing patch now on canary, will post numbers in 10m. thanks.
Maria: :thumbsup: if you need help with the GC patch I can take it after Luca's run.
Luca: results: after forcing 32-align and doubling sweep frequency, memory growth stopped in 30m window. pprof snapshot now:
```
60MB  20%  20%  300MB 100%  kv_cache::page_table
30MB  10%  30%  30MB  10%  rope::scale::cached_scales
``` 
Amy: nice. file an RFC for kernel selector ABI change and add the new metric. I'll open the infra ticket for a quick rollback toggle.
infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4523 rollback toggle for opt-v2a alignment :ticket:
Luca: filing perf postmortem with logs and patch link.
Maria: add notes about MQA per-shard padding — model team might be able to tweak shard alignment too.
Raj: also add a regression test: spin a long-context load in CI that asserts resident growth < 5% over 1h for Qwen-MQA.
Amy: perfect. closing loop once RFC + ticket done. :white_check_mark:
